system.effect:
Trigger: You use Leer or a Roughneck Move
Effect: The Move gains additional effects.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.XQOEuOenSzYNz4eO]{Leer}: Attacks against affected foes gain a +2 Bonus to their Critical Range for one full round.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.jA1lUJTWb7izUm2l]{Chip Away}: The target is considered @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.wqzPWKMbwvOWLVoI]{Vulnerable} against this attack, and may not activate Interrupts or Moves with the @CompSearch[Moves keywords=Shield]{Shield} Keyword in response to it.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.4a68jMGmkXi2pkfF]{Headbutt}: The target is automatically @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.xE6uIFWZoYXAZQxA]{Flinched}, and you may initiate a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.79nCOdXheYY2AXTB]{Push Maneuver} against the target, using your Intimidate or Athletics skill. This Maneuver automatically hits, but you must still roll an opposed check.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.VUD1mCjhImVmtttd]{Glare}: The target loses 2 Speed Combat Stages, and is @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.I2nVAxBFKDMe8EQt]{Slowed} for one full round. This occurs whether Glare hits or misses.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.mddjD9rQYW5169un]{Mean Look}: The target is @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.uxkB2vhF5HGjQAZY]{Suppressed} for one full round, and has a random Move @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.GUKAMwsFi0EJ56WD]{Disabled}.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.IAFYzSRQGxZM1SSQ]{Endure}: You gain two Ticks of Temporary Hit Points.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.hP6wlI0unApyOP9E]{Slack Off}: You are cured of one Status Affliction.
system.name: Fearsome Display [CR]
